algorithm: Naive kernel assigns one output element per thread. Tiled kernel loads A/B blocks into shared memory, synchronizes, accumulates products and zero-pads tail tiles. Row-major cuBLAS uses C^T=B^T A^T by swapping operands. Reference: https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cuda-c-programming-guide/ and https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/cublas/ .
architecture: Python validation harness → NumPy exact baseline and CPU methods. Native build → C++ CPU target plus optional CUDA kernels/benchmark. CUDA events exclude host/device transfers from measured kernel loops.
data_model: Matrices use row-major float arrays. Multiplication dimensions M,K,N determine MxN output. GPU harness currently benchmarks square matrices; Python tests cover rectangles.
description: Raw CUDA naive and shared-memory tiled kernels with a cuBLAS timing harness and independently validated CPU references.
design: Separate correctness from timing. Warm up each GPU method, execute ten repetitions and check absolute error against CPU results. Report event timings with device/toolkit details.
family_notes: Check tiled multiplication with a 16-element tile.
Check tiled multiplication with a 32-element CPU tile.
Multiply rectangular matrices with unequal inner/output dimensions.
Test dimensions that leave partial tiles.
limitations: CUDA, cuBLAS, CMake and Nsight are not available in the generation environment. GPU sources are uncompiled and unexecuted here. Python tile32 is a CPU workload; only tile16 is provided in CUDA. No GPU speedup, memory-throughput or transformer-scale claim. cuBLAS may select hardware-specific math paths.
operations: Run scripts/native_build.py for C++ verification. On an NVIDIA workstation use cmake -S native -B build; cmake --build build; ./build/cuda_benchmark 128. Review GPU error tolerance for larger shapes.
scope: Runnable Python CPU oracles, compiled C++ CPU baseline, raw naive CUDA kernel, 16x16 shared-memory CUDA kernel, CUDA-event timing and cuBLAS comparison source.
security: Treat this as educational code; review it before handling trusted data.
title: GPU Matrix Multiplication Kernel & Profiler
